paths.label: shown
paths.quote: It wont compile; Dividing by zero isnt allowed; so the compiler stops you before it runs
paths.logic: Folk meaning: in maths division by zero is 'impossible', so every x / 0 must be rejected, ideally by the compiler. Java rule: the compiler accepts it; int or long / and % by zero throw ArithmeticException at run time, while double division by zero is legal and gives Infinity or NaN.

paths.logic: Dividing an int by zero compiles but throws ArithmeticException when the program runs: a run-time error.
